title: The periodic harmonic orbit preserves every convergent positive charge-analytic tier sum

charge_hierarchy.orbit_data: K1589 has only k=0 modes, equal species amplitudes, constant |a|=A and constant scalar amplitude R, while |dot a|=A Omega>0.
charge_hierarchy.base_conservation: K1593 applies for all time and gives H_+(t)+H_-(t)=constant although the angular holonomy total variation diverges linearly.
charge_hierarchy.tier_lift: The global charge generator has eigenvalues of equal absolute value on the two species. Applying Q^n multiplies the paired matter energies by the same even factor, so the angular cancellation holds at every charge tier.
charge_hierarchy.analytic_sum: Every convergent positive charge-analytic sum of the adapted tier energies is constant on the orbit.
charge_hierarchy.interpretation: K1589 rejects energy-only L1_t control of the harmonic electric field but does not obstruct every cancellation-based positive-radius mechanism; its own infinite-variation angular motion has zero signed hierarchy cost.
charge_hierarchy.scope_guard: This orbit theorem supplies no decay, unequal-mode stability, oscillatory Maxwell estimate, current/radial remainder bound or global nonlinear positive-radius flow.
